## History

Peter Sloane is a local resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who participates in community affairs. He is involved with the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) during their project to repaint the local hall. Along with other villagers, he witnesses the public outcry and subsequent shift in sympathy toward the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) mistakenly paints the hall bright blue instead of green.

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P1](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0001), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P2](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0002), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P5](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0005), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P6](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0006), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P7](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0007), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P14](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0014), +85 more_
